hero.description:
Full-Stack Developer.
MERN Stack Specialist.
Based in Egypt.
Building fast, and effective apps.

list.title: Nexus Board
list.description: Bento-styled game completion board designed for focused gamers. Built with the latest Next.js App Router and integrated with Google Gemini for intelligent achievement roadmaps.

list.title: Movie Intelligence App
list.description: Cinematic platform featuring Firebase authentication, global state management, and an advanced IMDB-style rating algorithm.

list.title: 3D Web
list.description: A vertical storytelling experience exploring 7 distinct approaches to 3D browser rendering. Serves as a technical reference for complex WebGL pipelines, Spline, Globe.gl, and native CSS trigonometry.

list.title: Verdant Plants Store
list.description: Fully functional e-commerce boutique powered by WordPress and WooCommerce.

list.title: Lead Scraper
list.description: Freelancer automation tool. Scrapes Twitter (X) and Reddit for targeted web development client leads using Python and Selenium.

list.title: Vanilla JS E-Commerce
list.description: A pure Vanilla JavaScript e-commerce engine with an integrated cart, seamless checkout flow, and custom modal windows.

list.title: BearBuzz
list.description: Dual-interface (CLI & GUI) Python engine tracking stock volatility, dispatching automated Twilio SMS alerts with live financial headlines.

list.title: CLI Expense Tracker
list.description: Memory-safe, blazingly fast command-line tool featuring dynamic allocation and file I/O.
